levels.description: Documentation or isolated non-runtime metadata with no permission or data impact.
Scoped subsystem changes with bounded dependencies and reversible behavior.
Authentication, authorization, security, data model, migrations, cross-system contracts or broad runtime changes.
Production data deletion, secret exposure, privilege escalation, irreversible operations or production deployment.

rules: When impact is unknown, do not downgrade risk; request evidence.
Risk may be raised during review but cannot be lowered without documented rationale.
Destructive actions require a reversible quarantine or verified backup where technically possible.
This policy defines intended governance; enforcement is not active until the corresponding backend exists.
